title: Cone 6 Soda Firing Workshop
commitment: Thurs 8/27 classroom · Sat 10/10 load · Sun 10/11 fire · Sun 10/18 unload
summary: A hands-on soda firing workshop taught by Doug Dotson held at ArtsCenter (Carrboro) in August 2026, with load/fire/unload sessions at his studio in October. Students bring bisqued pots (about 25 mug-sized pieces per student), learn slip and glaze application, help load and fire, and unload together to see results.
how_to_join: Contact Doug Dotson for enrollment information.
bring: Bisqued pots (about 25 mug-sized pieces per student); food to share for potluck optional
source_quote: Cone 6 Soda Firing Workshop ArtsCenter August 2026
evidence_sentence: The workshop details page describes the August 2026 session at ArtsCenter with specific dates for classroom, loading, firing, and unloading at Doug Dotson Pottery.
evidence_quote: Thursday August 27, 2026, 6-9pm. Carrboro ArtsCenter. Surfaces and Slips for Soda Firing. Saturday October 10, 2026, 9am-3pm. Load the kiln. Doug Dotson Pottery
